chunks: The Thamud accused the messengers of lies.

key_terms.ثَمُودُ: The Thamud, an ancient Arab tribe mentioned in the Quran

ai.seo_question: Who were the Thamud and how did they respond to the messengers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the specific arrogance of Thamud, who rejected Prophet Salih not merely due to disbelief, but because they viewed his humble origins as a sign of weakness. This historical precedent serves as a theological model for the rejection of divine guidance by the elite, reinforcing the concept that true authority lies in divine selection rather than social status.
